## Evidence
- [ ] Tests added/updated for behavior changes.
- [ ] Offline regression suite passes.
- [ ] YAML/workflow validation passes when applicable.
- [ ] Security scan results reviewed; skipped/cancelled jobs are not counted as passes.
- [ ] Benchmark results include failed and timed-out cases.

## Security and operational impact
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, prompts, or private data added to logs/artifacts.
- [ ] No new filesystem, shell, browser, or network capability without an explicit threat-model update.
- [ ] No untrusted generated code executes outside a disposable, externally constrained sandbox.
- [ ] Any workflow permission changes are least-privilege and explained.
- [ ] Cost/quota impact is stated; unknown is not reported as zero.
